why: Issue #736. A DISCLOSED SURVIVOR, not an equivalent mutant: dropping the forwarding leaves the ?bench=preview workload with a preview that schedules on the window's own rAF, so the report never receives a frame. It survives because nothing vitest runs reaches this line: createTankPreview builds a WebGLRenderer, which jsdom cannot provide, so preview.test.ts exercises only the null-return branch. The composition test in tools/bench/preview-workload.test.ts drives createPreviewControls directly and so never goes through it either. What kills it is tools/gl/harness.ts's 'a preview handed a frame scheduler runs its loop through it (issue #736)', in a real browser. The replacement keeps `frames` read so the mutation compiles.
